profile.text: Mayer was born in Columbia and is a member of Rhine Lab. She is the inventor of the 'Meeboo' wire control system. She is outstandingly capable and runs her own workshop called 'Lutra.' She is currently working with Rhodes Island to provide assistance with construction, planning, and development.
